prompts.prompt: Edit target: the attached real product photograph of a military-green fabric garage, product 710. Produce a faithful 4:3 landscape ecommerce cover, 1600x1200 if possible. This is a minimal photographic crop/reframe, NOT a redesign. Trim only a small amount of empty surroundings at the left/right if safe; preserve the entire garage silhouette, roof apex, ground contact, open entrance, visible internal tubes, rear opening, fabric folds, colour and perspective exactly. If a pure crop would cut any product edge, instead extend a little of the existing sky/grass above/below. Keep the existing lighting and realistic photographic texture. Do not sharpen into invented structural details, add/remove poles, change the opening or clean up the site. Image content must reach every edge, no white bars, borders, labels or collage.

Preserve the ENTIRE existing photograph as a locked unchanged central horizontal strip: same tent, exact geometry and silhouette, folds, open entrance, ropes, tubes, people, cart, foreground and background. Keep full source width. Add approximately 110 pixels of matching blue sky above and 112 pixels of matching dry grass/earth below at source scale. Do not redraw, retouch or reinterpret anything inside the existing photo. Do not move or enlarge the tent. Continue the actual outdoor environment seamlessly, matching perspective and sunlight. No white margins, no borders, no labels, no collage. The tent must remain a factual photograph of this exact product. Output 4:3, ideally 1600x1200.
